meta.title: {clinic} — dental clinic in Vlorë, Albania
meta.description: Complete dental care in Vlorë: check-ups, fillings, root canal treatment, crowns and implants. A written treatment plan and the price agreed at the first visit.

cta.title: Come and have it looked at.
cta.body: Tell us what is bothering you and we will ring you back during opening hours. Nothing is started before you have the plan in writing and the price agreed.

treatments.metaDescription: Every treatment at our practice in Vlorë — check-ups, fillings, root canal treatment, crowns, veneers, extractions, oral surgery, implants, dentures, braces and whitening — with how many appointments each one takes and how long it keeps you here.
treatments.title: {count} treatments, and what each one asks of you.
treatments.lede: The same {count} the front page lists, with the part that would not fit on a card: what actually happens, how many appointments it takes, and how many days it keeps you in Vlorë.

detail.checkup: It takes about half an hour. We look at every tooth and at the gums around them, take a radiograph where there is something that cannot be seen from the outside, and clean off what a toothbrush cannot reach. You leave with a plan in the order things matter — what needs doing now, what can wait, and what only needs watching.
detail.fillings: The decayed part is removed and the tooth is rebuilt in a composite matched to the shade of your own enamel, layer by layer, and set hard with a lamp. It is done under local anaesthetic and you can eat as soon as you leave. A tooth treated early is a filling; the same tooth left alone becomes a root canal.
detail.rootCanal: When decay reaches the nerve the tooth is not lost — the canals are cleaned out, shaped and sealed to the tip of the root. It is done under anaesthetic, and it is the treatment that ends the pain rather than the one that causes it. A back tooth is usually crowned afterwards, because what is left of it is thinner than it was.
detail.crowns: A crown is made in a laboratory from an impression or a scan and covers what is left of the tooth. It is tried in before it is cemented, and the shade is chosen against the teeth either side of it rather than out of a catalogue. A bridge is the same work carrying a false tooth across a gap.
detail.veneers: A layer of porcelain about as thick as a fingernail, made in the laboratory and bonded to the front of the tooth. It is what we reach for when the colour will not come back with whitening, or when a tooth is small, worn or chipped. Very little enamel is removed, and in some cases none at all — but what is removed does not grow back, so which of the two your case is gets said before the work starts rather than after.
detail.extraction: Sometimes there is nothing left worth saving, and a wisdom tooth is more often in the way than in trouble. It is done under local anaesthetic, and what matters as much as the extraction itself is what you do for the two days after it — which you get in writing rather than said at the door.
detail.oralSurgery: The surgical work that takes more than a straightforward extraction: wisdom teeth still under the gum or inside the bone, fractured roots, and adding bone when what you have will not hold an implant. It is done under local anaesthetic and planned from an X-ray beforehand rather than worked out as it goes. You leave with written instructions and a review appointment already booked.
detail.implants: A titanium root is placed where the missing one was and then left alone while the bone grows onto it — that is the wait, and it is the part no clinic can shorten. Months later the crown goes on top. It is the only treatment here that replaces the root as well as the tooth, which is why the teeth either side of the gap are left untouched.
detail.dentures: When too many teeth are gone for a bridge, a denture replaces them and rests on the gums or on the teeth that remain. It is built in stages — impression, bite, a try-in in wax, then the finished one — and the wax try-in is there precisely so you can see the shape and the colour and change them while nothing has been cut. It takes more appointments than anything else on this page, and the first weeks are practice: speaking and eating with it is a habit that arrives.
detail.orthodontics: Fixed braces or clear aligners, depending on how far the teeth have to move and what you are willing to wear while they do it. You see the plan before the first bracket is fitted. It is the one treatment here measured in months rather than days, and most of those months are spent at home rather than in the chair.
detail.whitening: In the chair in one appointment, or with trays made for you to use at home over a week or two. It lifts the colour out of the enamel and takes nothing off it. Crowns and fillings do not change shade, so anything at the front is matched afterwards rather than before.

practice.metaDescription: Dr. Votim Shehu's practice in Vlorë: how the first visit goes, the rooms and the equipment in photographs, how the records are kept, and the three languages the practice works in.
practice.title: A practice that writes everything down.
practice.lede: Who does the work, what happens in the first hour, and the two things that are true of every appointment here whatever you came in for.

first.title: Your first visit, step by step.
first.lede: It is the appointment people put off the longest, so here is the whole of it before you book. Nothing on this list is done to you without being explained first.

listen.title: You tell us what brought you in
listen.body: Before anything is looked at. If it has been years, say so — it is the most common reason people come, and nobody here is going to make a point of it.

examine.title: A full examination
examine.body: Every tooth and the gums around them, and a radiograph where there is something that cannot be seen from the outside. It takes about half an hour and none of it hurts.

record.title: What we found, tooth by tooth
record.body: Written into your chart as we go, per tooth rather than as a paragraph — so what was found today is in front of us at the next visit, and at the one after that.

plan.title: The plan, and the price
plan.body: In writing, in the order things matter: what needs doing now, what can wait, and what only needs watching. The price is agreed here rather than at the end.

decide.title: You decide
decide.body: Nothing is started at the first visit unless you want it started. Take the plan away, think about it, ring us back — it stays on your record either way.

languages.title: Three languages, no interpreter.
languages.lede: A treatment plan explained through a relative on a video call is how somebody ends up agreeing to work they did not understand. Everything here — the examination, the plan, the instructions for afterwards — happens in whichever of these three you are most comfortable in.
languages.sq: The practice's own language, and the one the records are kept in.
languages.en: For patients from the UK and Ireland, and for everybody who lands somewhere in between.
languages.it: A short flight from the other side of the Adriatic, and a good share of our patients make it.

clinic.lede: Four things that are true of every appointment at this practice, whether you live two streets away or landed this morning.

plan.title: The plan and the price, in writing
plan.body: You leave the first visit knowing what is to be done, how many appointments it takes and what it costs. It does not change along the way without being said out loud.

languages.title: Albanian, Italian, English
languages.body: The work is explained in the language you think in. No interpreter and no nodding along — which matters most in the appointment where you are being asked to decide something.

record.title: An electronic record, tooth by tooth
record.body: Your chart is kept per tooth, so what was found last year is on the screen this year. If you are treated here across two trips, the second starts where the first stopped.

clean.title: Sterilised between patients
clean.body: Instruments are cleaned, packed and sterilised after every use, and single-use items are exactly that. It is the floor rather than a feature — but it is the question people are too polite to ask.

hours.lede: These seven rows are the practice's own hours, read from the same place the appointment book reads them. Change the surgery's hours and this page has already changed.
hours.caption: Opening hours, Monday to Sunday
hours.note: Open does not mean free. The hours here are when somebody is at the desk; which of those hours are still unbooked is what the booking page asks about.

abroad.metaDescription: Dental treatment in Vlorë for patients travelling from Italy, the UK and further: how many appointments and how many days each treatment takes, the three ways into the city, and what happens once you have flown home.
abroad.title: The journey, and what comes after it.
abroad.lede: How many appointments each treatment takes and how many days that keeps you here, the three ways into Vlorë, and what the practice does once you have gone home again.

getting.title: Three ways into Vlorë.
getting.lede: A good share of the people who sit in this chair did not start the day in Albania. Tell us how you are travelling and when you arrive, and the appointments are fitted around the journey rather than the other way about.

air.title: By air
air.body: Tirana is the international airport most patients fly into, and the road down to the coast is the usual way in from there. Send us your flight and we will tell you what can realistically be done on the day you arrive and what is better left to the morning after.

sea.title: By sea
sea.body: There are ferry crossings between Italy and the Albanian coast, and several of our Italian patients come this way rather than fly. Routes change from one summer to the next, so check the operator's own timetable — and tell us which crossing you are on.

road.title: By road
road.body: Vlorë is on the coast road, and patients drive in from Tirana, from the south and from the Greek border. If you are coming a long way for a first appointment, write to us before you set off rather than after.

getting.bayCaption: Vlorë sits on the bay. It is the one photograph on this site genuinely taken here, which is why it is used where the page talks about travelling rather than as decoration.

city.title: Vlorë, if you have never been.
city.lede: A working port on the Albanian coast, and the town this practice has always been in. Most patients who fly in make a few days of it rather than turning straight round.

seas.title: Where two seas meet
seas.body: Vlorë sits at the point the Adriatic gives way to the Ionian. It is why the water changes colour halfway down the bay, and why the coast south of the town looks nothing like the coast north of it.

history.title: Where the country began
history.body: Albania declared its independence here, in 1912, and the town has the flag, the square and the museum to say so. If you have an afternoon between appointments, the old town and the waterfront are within a walk of each other.

riviera.title: The Riviera starts above the town
riviera.body: The coast road climbs out of Vlorë and over the pass, and the beaches people mean when they say the Albanian Riviera are on the other side of it. It is the stretch worth a spare day, if you have one.

city.note: None of this is why anybody chooses a dentist, and it is not offered as though it were. It is here because a first appointment abroad is a trip as well as a treatment, and it is fair to know what the place is.

book.title: Tell us when suits you.
book.lede: The calendar on this page is our own week, read from the same rows the surgery is run from. Nothing is booked by choosing a day: it is what we ring you back about.

treatment.stepsLede: The three steps every treatment here has: what is looked at first, what happens in the chair, and what you leave with.
treatment.timingLede: Appointments, days in Vlorë, and months from start to finish.
treatment.relatedLede: Not a sales list — what most often goes with this, or the other honest answer to the same problem.

one.title: The look
one.body: Every tooth, the gums around them, and an X-ray wherever something does not show from the outside.

two.title: The clean
two.body: Scale and staining come off with ultrasonics, including where the brush never reaches.

three.title: The plan
three.body: You leave with the order of work: what now, what can wait, and what is only kept under watch.

one.title: Anaesthetic
one.body: Only the tooth being worked on, and we wait until you feel nothing.

two.title: Clearing the decay
two.body: All of the affected part comes out; what is left underneath is sound tooth.

three.title: Rebuilding
three.body: Composite goes in layer by layer in the shade of your enamel and is cured. You can eat as soon as you leave.

one.title: Diagnosis
one.body: The X-ray shows how far the infection has gone and how many canals the tooth has.

two.title: Cleaning the canals
two.body: Under anaesthetic. The canals are cleaned, shaped and sealed to the tip of the root.

three.title: Covering it
three.body: The tooth is closed, and on a back tooth a crown usually follows it.

one.title: Preparation
one.body: The tooth is shaped and an impression or a scan taken; you leave with a temporary crown.

two.title: The laboratory
two.body: The crown is made in porcelain or zirconia, and the shade is chosen against the teeth beside it.

three.title: Try-in and fit
three.body: It is tried before it is cemented. If the bite or the colour does not convince, it goes back.

one.title: Agreeing the shape
one.body: Colour and shape are settled together, and how much enamel comes off is said beforehand.

two.title: Impression and laboratory
two.body: The veneers are made in porcelain on your own impression, not from a stock shell.

three.title: Bonding
three.body: Tried one at a time, then bonded. You bite normally from that day.

one.title: The X-ray
one.body: The root and what sits around it are seen before anything is touched.

two.title: The extraction
two.body: Under local anaesthetic. You feel pressure, not pain; if you feel pain, we stop.

three.title: The first two days
three.body: The instructions come in writing, and a number to call if something is not right.

one.title: Planning
one.body: The X-ray shows where the tooth is or how much bone there is, and the work is settled before it starts.

two.title: The procedure
two.body: Local anaesthetic, one appointment. It takes longer than a simple extraction, not worse.

three.title: Review
three.body: Stitches and healing are looked at in an appointment booked before you leave.

one.title: Will the bone hold it
one.body: The X-ray shows how much bone there is. If there is not enough, grafting comes first.

two.title: Placing it
two.body: The titanium root goes in under local anaesthetic, and then the bone is given time.

three.title: The crown
three.body: Three to six months later the crown goes on top. That is the second visit, usually the second trip.

one.title: Impression and bite
one.body: The shape of the gums and the way the jaws close are both recorded.

two.title: The wax try-in
two.body: You see it and try it before anything is final. Changes happen here.

three.title: Fitting and adjustment
three.body: It is fitted, then adjusted after the first week; sore spots are expected rather than a surprise.

one.title: The plan
one.body: Impressions, photographs and an X-ray, then the route the teeth will take — before the first bracket goes on.

two.title: The movement
two.body: Fixed braces or aligners, with a check every few weeks. Most of it happens away from the chair.

three.title: The retainer
three.body: When it is finished, the retainer is what holds it. Without one they drift slowly back.

one.title: The check first
one.body: Whitening is not done over decay or inflamed gums; those are dealt with first.

two.title: The whitening
two.body: In the clinic within one appointment, or with trays made for you to take home.

three.title: Keeping it
three.body: The new shade is measured and recorded. Crowns and fillings do not whiten, so they are matched afterwards.

hero.lede: Complete dental care in Vlorë — a precise diagnosis, a treatment plan in writing, and the price agreed at the first visit.
hero.ledeShort: “Be true to your teeth, and they won't be false to you.”

treatments.title: The work, shown rather than hidden.
treatments.lede: From the next check-up to an implant. For each one we tell you how many visits it takes and what it costs — before we start, not at the end.

checkup.title: Check-up and hygiene
checkup.body: A full examination, a scale and polish, and a plan in the order things matter. Everything starts here.

fillings.title: Fillings
fillings.body: The decay comes out and the tooth goes back to its own shape, in a composite matched to your enamel.

rootCanal.title: Root canal treatment
rootCanal.body: The canals are cleaned and sealed to the tip of the root. The tooth stays yours.

crowns.title: Crowns and bridges
crowns.body: When little of the tooth is left, a crown covers what remains. Made in the laboratory and tried in before it is fitted.

veneers.title: Veneers
veneers.body: Thin porcelain shells over the front of the tooth. The shape and the colour change; the tooth underneath stays.

extraction.title: Extractions
extraction.body: When there is nothing left to save, wisdom teeth included. Under anaesthetic, with clear instructions for afterwards.

oralSurgery.title: Oral surgery
oralSurgery.body: Teeth still buried in bone, broken roots, and the bone an implant needs first. Local anaesthetic, one appointment.

implants.title: Implants
implants.body: A titanium root where the missing one was, and a crown on top of it. The closest thing to the tooth you had.

dentures.title: Dentures
dentures.body: A full or partial denture where too many teeth are missing for a bridge. Tried in wax before anything is final.

orthodontics.title: Orthodontics
orthodontics.body: Fixed braces or clear aligners. The teeth move slowly into place, and you see the plan before the first one is fitted.

whitening.title: Whitening
whitening.body: In the chair, or with trays to take home. It takes nothing off the enamel — it gives back the colour you had.

concerns.title: What brings you in?

missing.label: A tooth is missing
missing.body: A gap changes how you bite and how the teeth either side of it sit. It can be filled with an implant — a new root with a crown on top — or bridged from the teeth beside it. Which one suits you depends on the bone underneath, and that is what the first visit looks at.

pain.label: Something hurts
pain.body: Pain is what we see soonest. Most of it is decay that has reached the nerve, and it is treated either with a filling or, once the nerve is involved, by cleaning and sealing the root. Ring us rather than waiting — it does not settle on its own.

looks.label: I do not like how they look
looks.body: Sometimes it is the colour and sometimes the shape. Whitening gives back the colour the enamel had and takes nothing off it; where a tooth is chipped or worn, a crown restores the shape. We tell you which is enough before anything is started.

crooked.label: My teeth are crooked
crooked.body: Fixed braces or clear aligners, depending on how far the teeth have to move and what you want to wear while they do it. You see the plan and the finishing position before the first one is fitted.

gums.label: My gums bleed
gums.body: Bleeding when you brush is usually the first sign of gum disease, and at that stage it can still be turned around. It starts with a full examination and a scale — not with treating the teeth themselves.

overdue.label: It has been years
overdue.body: That is the most common reason people come, and nobody here is going to make a point of it. A first appointment is an examination, a scale and polish, and a written plan in the order things matter — not a list of everything at once.

concerns.hint: Six reasons people come to us. Pick the one that sounds like you.

practice.bodyTwo: We work in Albanian, Italian and English — no interpreter and no misunderstandings, including if you are flying in for the treatment.

visit.travelBody: A good share of our patients fly in from Italy and the UK. Write to us before you travel: we will tell you how many visits it takes, how many days it keeps you here and what it costs — before you buy the ticket.

visit.bookBody: Our own calendar is on the booking page — the days it offers are days the practice is open. Choose one, leave a number, and we agree the hour on the telephone.

trip.title: How long would it keep you here?
trip.lede: Tick what you are asking about and we will show how many appointments it takes, how many days it keeps you in Vlorë, and whether that is one trip or two.
trip.empty: Tick a treatment and the estimate appears here.
trip.oneTrip: One trip. Everything here is done in a single stay.
trip.twoTrips: Two trips. The first places the work, then it needs time to heal before the second finishes it.
trip.caveat: An indication, not a quote. What it actually takes depends on the examination — and you get the plan, how many visits, how long and what it costs, in writing at the first visit.
trip.pricesReviewed: Prices last checked {date}. The figure agreed at your first visit is the one that counts.

aftercare.title: And when you have flown home.
aftercare.lede: It is the question that decides whether somebody books at all, and the one a website usually leaves out. Nothing here is promised for the occasion — it is what the practice already does, written down.

instructions.title: Written instructions before you leave
instructions.body: What to do, what to avoid and for how long — on paper, in the language you were treated in. Not a leaflet in Albanian handed to somebody who does not read Albanian.

checkIn.title: We write to you a few days later
checkIn.body: A message asking how you are getting on, sent from the practice's own follow-up board rather than left to somebody remembering. If anything hurts or does not feel right, you reply to it and we take it from there.

record.title: Your record goes where you go
record.body: Kept electronically, tooth by tooth, with the plan and what was actually done. Ask for it and it is sent — to you, or to a dentist at home who needs to know what is in your mouth.

wrong.title: If something is wrong, say so early
wrong.body: Ring or write, in whichever of the three languages you were treated in. The practice's own follow-up message ends on exactly that offer and means it: we would far rather hear about it early than at your next check-up.

Reply to this message and we will find a time that suits you.

{signature}

Reply to this message if you would rather come another day.

{signature}

If anything is painful or does not feel right, reply to this message and we will see you.

{signature}
